description.value: Saltchuck Pie Company is a Victoria bakery cafe specializing in hot, savoury pies made in the Australian and New Zealand tradition — tender flaky pastry filled with local ingredients like steak, chicken, lamb, and seasonal produce. Located in the Rock Bay neighbourhood near the Bay Street bridge, the menu rotates daily to reflect Vancouver Island's seasonal bounty. The business also operates a food truck that appears at festivals and events throughout Southern Vancouver Island.
